content.text: The Cleveland Guardians and Atlanta Braves face-off on Sunday in MLB action. Truist Park is set to host the exciting matchup between the Cleveland Guardians and the Atlanta Braves on Sunday in MLB regular season action. Down 2-1 heading into the bottom of the sixth inning, Ronald Acuña hit a solo home run to left field to lead-off the inning and equalize at 2-2. Then, Matt Olson followed suit on a fly ball to right field, bringing in Drake Baldwin as well to make it 4-2. Shortly after, Dominic Smith’s single brought in Austin Riley before Michael Harris II homered to right center field to bring Smith in himself and make it 7-2 Braves in an explosive sixth inning.
